body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: c5617569632f54572d8909e43a620ac83ca1ce25 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (merge #595 first; this branch carries its commit 2fbe362b, so the review below covers #588's own commit c5617569 on top).

**What looks good**
- The CLI now builds `Stock::block(Backend::Field{..})`, simulates via `Stock::simulate` and reads cells through `Columns` (`crates/sim/src/bin/camcraft-sim.rs:96-122`). No `Dexel` is left in the binary. Input validation and error paths are untouched and every refusal still names its cause.
- The verdict inputs are not looser. `bad_rapids` is pure move geometry (unchanged). `through` depends on `lowest`, which still reads `top_at`. A NaN column counts as uncut, exactly as the old `is_finite()` guard did.
- No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`, no new dependency, no `build.rs`/scripts/.github change, provenance lines intact, no golden or snapshot change. Files stay under ~400 lines (columns.rs 229, prior.rs 167).

**Local results (trial merge with current upstream/main, clean merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `headless_bin` | 3 passed |
| `prior_columns` | 2 passed |
| `stock_columns` | 3 passed |
| `stock_backend_parity` | 13 passed |
| camcraft-sim `--lib` | 65 passed |
| app `drill_prior` 12, `drill_prior_kinds` 4, `drill_reach` 6, `drill_rplane` 8 | all passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Independent old-vs-new check** (release binaries built from upstream/main's CLI and from this head): I did not rely on the recorded runs. At `--cell 0.75`, 5 goldens (slot_fullwidth_centerline, face_square_40x40, contour_disc_hole, pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island, finish3d_project_dome) x flat 6 mm on box -60 -60 -25 60 60 0, plus ball 10 mm on a shallow box -60 -60 -3 60 60 5 (forces cuts below the stock bottom): 10 of 10 byte-identical in full output and exit code, including the FLAGGED/exit 2 runs (slot, pocket-ball, contour-ball, slot-ball). The default-cell drill_plate run also matches your table (224.297 mm^3, 399 cells). Bad `--cell` values (0, nan, -1, 1e-9, 1e9), a missing file, a degenerate box and a non-positive diameter give the same message and exit code on both binaries.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Speed is worth stating plainly in the body. The PR says the field engine is slower "in a debug build". In release, `camcraft-sim crates/app/tests/golden/drill_plate.cl -60 -60 -25 60 60 0 6` (default cell 0.375 mm, 320x320) took about 79 s on the new binary versus 0.23 s on the old (roughly 300x), on this Mac. Output is identical, so this is not a safety issue, but a user running the CLI on a full-size box at the default cell will notice. Consider a coarser `auto_cell` for the field arm or a note in `--help`; this can be a follow-up issue rather than a blocker. (`--cell 1.5` ran in 2.4 s.)
2. The 10 recorded runs in the body were not re-run by me at the default cell because of the speed above; the byte-identical check above used `--cell 0.75`.
3. Process: body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #588`; commit subjects are conventional. Stacking on #595 is declared in the body but the PR base is `main`, so merge #595 first or GitHub will fold its commit in.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
